verdict.rationale: Cekura ships a documented OpenAPI-based API, SDKs (sync/async), a CLI to manage agents/scenarios/runs/call data, and an MCP server plus 'skills' for AI-agent integration, indicating broad programmatic parity with core workflows (create runs, evaluate, dashboards, send calls). However, some UI-centric features like custom dashboard building and cronjob/GitHub Actions setup are only described as guides without explicit confirmation that every UI action (e.g., dashboard widget creation) has a direct API/CLI equivalent. Missing for 10: explicit 1:1 mapping/documentation confirming all UI features (e.g., visual dashboard builder, live drift detection UI) are fully replicable via API/CLI, and independent verification of completeness.
